name: Wisconsin

examVariants.label: Under-18 knowledge test - Class D (regular license)
Adult knowledge test - Class D (regular license)

retake.retakeFee: No additional fee to retake the knowledge test

gdl.fullLicenseMinAge: 18 (or when GDL restrictions end after 9 months of probationary licensing)
gdl.nightCurfew: Probationary drivers under 18 may not drive midnight-5 a.m. for the first 9 months (with limited exceptions)
gdl.passengerLimits: For the first 9 months of a probationary license, only one passenger (plus immediate family) unless a qualified adult supervisor is present

requiredDocuments: Proof of name and date of birth
Proof of Wisconsin residency (two documents for a REAL ID)
Proof of legal presence / U.S. citizenship or lawful status
Application form MV3001 (and school enrollment/sponsorship if under 18)
process.realIdNotes: A REAL ID-compliant license requires proof of identity/date of birth, one proof of Social Security number, proof of legal presence, and two proofs of Wisconsin residency. Must be applied for in person.
process.licenseFee: $28 (probationary license, valid 2 years); $34 for a regular 8-year license
process.visionStandard: At least 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.bacLimitUnder21: 0.00% (Absolute Sobriety / Not a Drop law - any detectable alcohol)
facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12 or more demerit points within 12 months leads to suspension
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane, or slow down if you cannot, for stopped emergency, tow, and highway maintenance vehicles displaying flashing warning lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 70 mph on rural interstates where posted
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Reduced posted limit near schools when children are present (commonly 15 mph)

verifyNote: The current official WisDOT BDS126 handbook and current knowledge-test page confirm the requirements, but WisDOT does not identify an edition year for the live handbook PDF; handbookEditionYear remains 2025 pending an edition-dated official source.
